articles.title: Grayscale quietly drops Cardano, Polkadot and Hedera ETF plans
articles.snippet: The asset manager said it no longer intends to proceed with the offerings. None became effective, and no securities were issued or sold.

articles.title: Controversial Bitcoin fork BIP-110 mines two blocks, then stops
articles.snippet: The breakaway chain inherited bitcoin’s mining difficulty with only a tiny share of hashpower, leaving blocks hours apart while both chains still accept the same transactions.

articles.title: Australia orders Cryptolink Bitcoin ATMs offline over ‘basic reporting’ failures
articles.snippet: Australia’s financial watchdog has suspended Cryptolink’s registration for three months, adding to a crackdown that previously saw the Bitcoin ATM operator fined $56,340.

articles.title: BIP-110 Bitcoin branch stalls after two blocks as gap widens
articles.snippet: The enforcing fork remains stuck at Bitcoin’s full mining difficulty as mandatory signaling proceeds with little hashpower support.

articles.title: Brazil targets crypto fraud with up to 24-hour transfer hold
articles.snippet: The rules, effective Jan. 1, 2027, cover transactions above $10,000 sent to overseas providers or self-custody wallets, along with other transfers flagged for review.
